• Crucial Action: Immediately notify bank branch manager and call ATM helpline. Change debit card PIN immediately from another verified ATM.
• Emergency Help: Call National Cybercrime Helpline at 1930 or file on cybercrime.gov.in.
keywords: compromised debit card pin at atm
